name: Bug report

---

**Describe the bug**
Please don't just post the crash report and tell how did you get the issue and how can I recreate it.

**Paste Sites and What to paste**
Don't just post the file itself and wait me to install, use a paste site.
Anything except Pastebin is sufficient. My suggestion is https://mclo.gs/

**Expected behavior**
If the issue is not something like a "bug" but rather acts weirdly, please state how it should actually act.

**Additional Resources**
This best can be picture/video that shows what's happening and if there isn't any video screenshots of people complaining so I can't push it under the rug and tell you "works in my machine".
This isn't mandatory though.

**Notes**
This might be weird information about your machine, server or whatever that you think the reason might be happening on you but no one else or stuffs like that.
